description: This file defines a SampleChooserTargetService class extending ChooserTargetService to provide custom Direct Share options in Android. It constructs a list of ChooserTarget objects based on a list of contacts, each with an associated icon and intent to launch a specific activity.

classes.name: SampleChooserTargetService
classes.description: A service providing custom direct share targets to the Android system by generating a list of Contact-based chooser targets.

methods.name: onGetChooserTargets
methods.description: Overrides the method to generate a list of ChooserTarget objects for specific contacts, each with associated icon and intent to launch the SendMessageActivity.
